title: Cyan: verified intermediate-state recovery

rounds.label: Rigid waypoint
rounds.attempt: The first joined rehearsal aborted during carry.
rounds.diagnosis: The hand was stable, but its intermediate position missed the requested tolerance.
rounds.change: Inspect the actual state rather than treating a missed waypoint as a completed motion.
rounds.outcome: The failure record isolated a stable intermediate pose, not a dropped piece.

rounds.label: Local recovery
rounds.attempt: Retain the real intermediate state and check it again.
rounds.diagnosis: A task-independent waypoint can be replaced only after stability and geometry checks.
rounds.change: Verify the held state, acquire fresh RGB, and replan the next leg.
rounds.outcome: The recovery ran in simulation; all three pieces were released and independently verified.

earlier_run.outcome: MotorAccuracyError before transport checkpoint; no release.

repair.description: For explicit nonterminal partial joint carry only: verify the actual held belief and complete/material/finite-hand geometry, wait and recheck stability, then require a fresh actual image and replanning. The original waypoint and terminal goal remain explicitly unreached. The terminal tolerance is unchanged.

scope: Fresh given four-piece prefix followed by continuous Purple → Cyan → Mint in one native episode. Prefix-conditioned 5–7 qualification; independent error/speed scope includes the given and executed pieces, with all twelve objects retained in contact and hand-clearance checks.
